pdfUrls.title: PDF URLs
pdfUrls.description: Direct links to the PDFs you want read. Scanned or photographed pages are the point here; if a PDF already has a text layer the Actor uses it directly instead of running OCR.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: Tesseract language codes, most likely first. Installed: eng, deu, fra, spa, ita, por, nld, kor, jpn, chi_sim.

outputMode.title: What to return
outputMode.description: Tables only, page text only, or both.

dpi.title: Render resolution (DPI)
dpi.description: Higher is more accurate and slower. 300 suits most scans; try 400 for small print, 200 for clean large type.

minConfidence.title: Minimum word confidence
minConfidence.description: 0-100. Words OCR is less sure about than this are reported as unreadable rather than as text. Raise it for cleaner text, lower it if characters go missing.

minColumns.title: Minimum columns
minColumns.description: Ignore tables with fewer columns. Keep this at 2 or more so paragraphs are not mistaken for tables.

maxPagesPerPdf.title: Max pages per PDF
maxPagesPerPdf.description: 0 means every page. OCR is charged per page, so cap this if you only need the front of a long document.

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger PDFs are skipped with an explanatory record.

forceOcr.title: Always run OCR
forceOcr.description: Off by default: a PDF that already has a text layer is read directly, which is faster, free of OCR errors and cheaper for you. Turn this on if the existing text layer is itself bad.

includeMarkdown.title: Include Markdown output
includeMarkdown.description: Adds a Markdown table to every table record.

includeCsv.title: Include CSV output
includeCsv.description: Adds a CSV string to every table record.
